doc: Makes a system function handle add events. The function will be called once an entity has the required components.
Makes a system function handle updates. Each update, it will be called for every entity that has the required components.
Makes a system function handle remove events. The function will be called when an entity loses one of the required components, if it previously had all of them.
Marks a type so that when added to an entity, if it already had a component of that type, a remove event will be dispatched first.
Sets the priority of a system or system function. Higher priorities happen first, and negative priorities are possible. The default priority is 0.
Sets the ComponentStorage instance used to store components of this type.
